categories.main_business_segments: Tung Ho Textile Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the textile industry, focusing on yarn spinning including general and special functional yarns. The company also engages in real estate leasing and development, international trade, and related services such as warehousing and retail. Their product portfolio includes eco-friendly and recycled yarns, functional composite yarns, and specialty yarns for various applications including apparel, home textiles, and industrial uses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced spinning technologies such as SIRO, Compact, SIRO+Compact, and SIRO-Fuse to produce high-quality yarns. They focus on developing environmentally sustainable yarns using recycled materials and organic cotton, incorporating functional fibers with properties like moisture-wicking, temperature regulation, antibacterial, and elasticity. Production methods emphasize energy efficiency, carbon footprint reduction, and quality control through knowledge management and big data analytics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Tung Ho Textile serves international brand customers and various industries including apparel, home furnishings, footwear, industrial fire-resistant fabrics, e-commerce, and functional textiles. Their key customers are global textile brands seeking sustainable and functional yarns. The company also targets emerging markets such as industrial and medical sectors to diversify its customer base.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Tainan City and sales offices in Taipei. It serves both domestic and international markets, exporting yarn products globally. The report highlights efforts to expand overseas markets and strengthen relationships with international brand clients.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tung Ho Textile operates primarily in the midstream segment of the textile supply chain, focusing on yarn production from raw fibers. It sources raw materials like polyester cotton and natural fibers from global suppliers and supplies yarns to downstream fabric manufacturers and brands. The company also engages in upstream activities such as raw material procurement and downstream activities like leasing and retail through its real estate assets.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in sustainable and functional yarn development, including full recycling of textile waste, composite yarns combining long and short fibers, and eco-friendly raw materials like biodegradable fibers and plant-based fibers. It invests in digital transformation, knowledge management systems, and energy-saving technologies to enhance production efficiency and product quality. Future R&D focuses on low-carbon yarns, reducing microfiber pollution, and integrating supply chain feedback for innovative product development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of spun yarn products, including general and specialty yarns. Additional income streams include rental income from real estate properties and government subsidies. The company follows a residual dividend policy balancing shareholder returns and reinvestment for growth.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces intense competition from imported yarns and other domestic textile manufacturers. Tung Ho Textile positions itself as a leader in high-value-added functional and sustainable yarns, leveraging advanced spinning technologies and close collaboration with international brands to differentiate its products. It emphasizes quality stability and environmental sustainability as competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of the latest fiscal year, Tung Ho Textile has a capital stock of NT$2.2 billion and total assets around NT$4.46 billion. Revenue declined by approximately 15% to NT$689 million due to reduced orders amid global economic challenges. Net profit decreased by about 27% to NT$104 million. The company maintains solid liquidity with a current ratio above 160% and continues to invest in R&D and sustainability initiatives despite market headwinds.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Tung Ho Textile offers differentiated value through its focus on sustainable, eco-friendly, and functional yarns that meet international brand standards. Its unique composite yarn technologies combine the strengths of various fibers to deliver superior performance and comfort. The company’s commitment to environmental responsibility, including carbon footprint reduction and textile recycling, enhances its market appeal and supports long-term supply chain partnerships.
